summary: Frontend regression for reordered Intl Shipments overview tiles (In pipeline / Messages / Needing payment / Needing shipping instructions). All specified flows and selectors pass. Draft-created shipment correctly enables the instructions tile with count 1; is-act-send-instr advances to 'instructions' and resets tile to 0/disabled. 0 console errors, 0 page errors, 0 horizontal overflow at 1920x800 and 390x844.
critical_code_review_comments: Instructions tile filter selects status='ready' (setFStatus('ready')), but the tile counts ready+draft. As expected/spec'd, clicking the tile shows 0 rows when only a draft exists. Consider a compound filter (ready||draft) or renaming small caption to indicate this.
IntlShipmentsPage.tsx (~465 lines) still bundles list + Detail (~180 lines). Extract Detail into its own file for maintainability.
is-kpi-released testid label is semantically 'awaiting prepayment' — consider renaming to is-focus-prepay.

Nested <em class='is-tile-link'> onClick handlers inside <button class='is-tile'> are not keyboard-focusable independently; consider restructuring as a div container + inner buttons for tile filter and actions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 tiles render in requested order (In pipeline / Messages / Needing payment / Needing shipping instructions) with counts 3/2/1/0. Instructions tile disabled when 0, becomes 1 & enabled after draft creation, resets to 0 after is-act-send-instr. Clicking instructions tile filters to status='ready' (not 'ready||draft'), so drafts don't appear — spec calls this out as acceptable. All regression selectors verified.
